verses.original: וְיִפְתָּ֣ח הַגִּלְעָדִ֗י הָיָה֙ גִּבּ֣וֹר חַ֔יִל וְה֖וּא בֶּן־ אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד גִּלְעָ֖ד אֶת־ יִפְתָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yip̄·tāḥ hag·gil·‘ā·ḏî hā·yāh gib·bō·wr ḥa·yil wə·hū ben- ’iš·šāh zō·w·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ gil·‘āḏ ’eṯ- yip̄·tāḥ
verses.literal: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor he was the son . . . of a prostitute and Gilead was his father
verses.literalPt: Ora, Jefté, gileadita, era ilustre em valor, mas filho de uma prostituta; Gileade gerou a Jefté.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֧לֶד אֵֽשֶׁת־ גִּלְעָ֛ד ל֖וֹ בָּנִ֑ים וַיִּגְדְּל֨וּ בְֽנֵי־ הָאִשָּׁ֜ה וַיְגָרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ יִפְתָּ֗ח וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לוֹ֙ לֹֽא־ תִנְחַ֣ל בְּבֵית־ אָבִ֔ינוּ כִּ֛י בֶּן־ אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֖רֶת אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ ’ê·šeṯ- gil·‘āḏ lōw bā·nîm way·yiḡ·də·lū ḇə·nê- hā·’iš·šāh way·ḡā·rə·šū ’eṯ- yip̄·tāḥ way·yō·mə·rū lōw lō- ṯin·ḥal bə·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇî·nū kî ben- ’iš·šāh ’a·ḥe·reṯ ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: And Gilead’s . . . wife bore him sons who . . . grew up drove Jephthah out and said to him You shall have no inheritance in our father’s house because you are the son of another woman
verses.literalPt: A mulher de Gileade deu-lhe filhos; quando os filhos de sua mulher eram já grandes, expulsaram a Jefté e disseram-lhe: Não herdarás na casa de nosso pai, pois és filho de outra mulher.

verses.original: וַיִּבְרַ֤ח יִפְתָּח֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י אֶחָ֔יו וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ ט֑וֹב וַיִּֽתְלַקְּט֤וּ אֶל־ יִפְתָּח֙ אֲנָשִׁ֣ים רֵיקִ֔ים וַיֵּצְא֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·raḥ yip̄·tāḥ mip·pə·nê ’e·ḥāw way·yê·šeḇ bə·’e·reṣ ṭō·wḇ way·yiṯ·laq·qə·ṭū ’el- yip̄·tāḥ ’ă·nā·šîm rê·qîm way·yê·ṣə·’ū ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob where worthless men gathered around . . . him . . . and traveled with him
verses.literalPt: Jefté fugiu de seus irmãos e habitou na terra de Tobe; agregaram-se-lhe homens miseráveis e saíam com ele.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י מִיָּמִ֑ים וַיִּלָּחֲמ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mî·yā·mîm way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Some time later . . . when the Ammonites . . . fought against Israel
verses.literalPt: Passado algum tempo, pelejaram os filhos de Amom contra Israel.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁר־ נִלְחֲמ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד לָקַ֥חַת אֶת־ יִפְתָּ֖ח מֵאֶ֥רֶץ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer- nil·ḥă·mū ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·lə·ḵū ziq·nê ḡil·‘āḏ lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- yip̄·tāḥ mê·’e·reṣ ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: and - made war with them the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob
verses.literalPt: Como os filhos de Amom pelejassem contra Israel, foram os anciãos de Gileade buscar da terra de Tobe a Jefté;

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְיִפְתָּ֔ח לְכָ֕ה וְהָיִ֥יתָה לָּ֖נוּ לְקָצִ֑ין וְנִֽלָּחֲמָ֖ה בִּבְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lə·yip̄·tāḥ lə·ḵāh wə·hā·yî·ṯāh lā·nū lə·qā·ṣîn wə·nil·lā·ḥă·māh biḇ·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: Come they said be our commander so that we can fight against the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: e disseram-lhe: Vem e sê o nosso chefe, para que combatamos contra os filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִפְתָּח֙ לְזִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד הֲלֹ֤א אַתֶּם֙ שְׂנֵאתֶ֣ם אוֹתִ֔י וַתְּגָרְשׁ֖וּנִי מִבֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וּמַדּ֜וּעַ בָּאתֶ֤ם אֵלַי֙ עַ֔תָּה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צַ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yip̄·tāḥ lə·ziq·nê ḡil·‘āḏ hă·lō ’at·tem śə·nê·ṯem ’ō·w·ṯî wat·tə·ḡā·rə·šū·nî mib·bêṯ ’ā·ḇî ū·mad·dū·a‘ bā·ṯem ’ê·lay ‘at·tāh ka·’ă·šer ṣar lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Jephthah replied to the elders of Gilead Did you not hate me and expel me from my father’s house Why then have you come to me now when you are in distress . . .
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Jefté aos anciãos de Gileade: Não sois vós os que me tivestes ódio, e que me expulsastes da casa de meu pai? Por que sois vindos a mim agora, quando vos achais em aperto?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ זִקְנֵ֨י גִלְעָ֜ד אֶל־ יִפְתָּ֗ח לָכֵן֙ עַתָּה֙ שַׁ֣בְנוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ֣ עִמָּ֔נוּ וְנִלְחַמְתָּ֖ בִּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהָיִ֤יתָ לָּ֙נוּ֙ לְרֹ֔אשׁ לְכֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ziq·nê ḡil·‘āḏ ’el- yip̄·tāḥ lā·ḵên ‘at·tāh šaḇ·nū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·hā·laḵ·tā ‘im·mā·nū wə·nil·ḥam·tā biḇ·nê ‘am·mō·wn wə·hā·yî·ṯā lā·nū lə·rōš lə·ḵōl yō·šə·ḇê ḡil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: They . . . answered Jephthah This is why we now turn . . . to you that you may go with us fight the Ammonites . . . and become leader over all of us who live in Gilead
verses.literalPt: Responderam a Jefté os anciãos de Gileade: É por isso que tornamos a ti, para que venhas conosco e pelejes contra os filhos de Amom. Ser-nos-ás por cabeça sobre todos os habitantes de Gileade.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִפְתָּ֜ח אֶל־ זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֗ד אִם־ מְשִׁיבִ֨ים אַתֶּ֤ם אוֹתִי֙ לְהִלָּחֵם֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וְנָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אוֹתָ֖ם לְפָנָ֑י אָנֹכִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yip̄·tāḥ ’el- ziq·nê ḡil·‘āḏ ’im- mə·šî·ḇîm ’at·tem ’ō·w·ṯî lə·hil·lā·ḥêm biḇ·nê ‘am·mō·wn wə·nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯām lə·p̄ā·nāy ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eh·yeh lā·ḵem lə·rōš
verses.literal: But Jephthah asked them . . . If you take me back to fight the Ammonites . . . and the LORD gives them to me will I really be your leader
verses.literalPt: Disse Jefté aos anciãos de Gileade: Se vós me fizerdes voltar para pelejar contra os filhos de Amom, e Jeová mos entregar nas mãos, serei eu vosso cabeça?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ זִקְנֵֽי־ גִלְעָ֖ד אֶל־ יִפְתָּ֑ח יְהוָ֗ה יִהְיֶ֤ה שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ בֵּֽינוֹתֵ֔ינוּ אִם־ לֹ֥א כִדְבָרְךָ֖ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ziq·nê- ḡil·‘āḏ ’el- yip̄·tāḥ Yah·weh yih·yeh šō·mê·a‘ bê·nō·w·ṯê·nū ’im- lō ḵiḏ·ḇā·rə·ḵā kên na·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah The LORD is our witness . . . if we do not do as you say . . .
verses.literalPt: Replicaram a Jefté os anciãos de Gileade: Jeová será testemunha entre nós, de que faremos conforme a tua palavra.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ יִפְתָּח֙ עִם־ זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וַיָּשִׂ֨ימוּ הָעָ֥ם אוֹת֛וֹ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְרֹ֣אשׁ וּלְקָצִ֑ין וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יִפְתָּ֧ח אֶת־ כָּל־ דְּבָרָ֛יו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ yip̄·tāḥ ‘im- ziq·nê ḡil·‘āḏ way·yā·śî·mū hā·‘ām ’ō·w·ṯōw ‘ă·lê·hem lə·rōš ū·lə·qā·ṣîn way·ḏab·bêr yip̄·tāḥ ’eṯ- kāl- də·ḇā·rāw lip̄·nê Yah·weh bam·miṣ·pāh
verses.literal: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead and the people made him their leader and commander And Jephthah repeated all his terms in the presence of the LORD at Mizpah
verses.literalPt: Foi Jefté com os anciãos de Gileade, e o povo fê-lo cabeça e chefe sobre si: e Jefté proferiu todas as suas palavras perante Jeová, em Mispa.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִפְתָּח֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן לֵאמֹ֑ר מַה־ לִּ֣י וָלָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־ בָ֥אתָ אֵלַ֖י לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם בְּאַרְצִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yip̄·tāḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- me·leḵ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn lê·mōr mah- lî wā·lāḵ kî- ḇā·ṯā ’ê·lay lə·hil·lā·ḥêm bə·’ar·ṣî
verses.literal: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites . . . saying What do you have against me . . . that you have come to fight against my land
verses.literalPt: Jefté enviou mensageiros ao rei dos filhos de Amom, que lhe dissessem: Que tens tu comigo, que vieste a mim para pelejares contra a minha terra?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֜וֹן אֶל־ מַלְאֲכֵ֣י יִפְתָּ֗ח כִּֽי־ לָקַ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶת־ אַרְצִי֙ בַּעֲלוֹת֣וֹ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם מֵאַרְנ֥וֹן וְעַד־ הַיַּבֹּ֖ק וְעַד־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְעַתָּ֕ה הָשִׁ֥יבָה אֶתְהֶ֖ן בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer me·leḵ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ’el- mal·’ă·ḵê yip̄·tāḥ kî- lā·qaḥ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣî ba·‘ă·lō·w·ṯōw mim·miṣ·ra·yim mê·’ar·nō·wn wə·‘aḏ- hay·yab·bōq wə·‘aḏ- hay·yar·dên wə·‘at·tāh hā·šî·ḇāh ’eṯ·hen bə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: The king of the Ammonites . . . answered Jephthah’s . . . messengers When Israel came up out of Egypt they seized my land from the Arnon to the Jabbok and all the way to the Jordan Now, therefore restore it peaceably
verses.literalPt: Respondeu o rei dos filhos de Amom aos mensageiros de Jefté: É porque Israel, vindo do Egito, me tomou a terra desde Arnom até Jaboque e o Jordão; agora restitui-me essas terras em paz.

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹסֶף ע֖וֹד יִפְתָּ֑ח וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־ מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·sep̄ ‘ō·wḏ yip̄·tāḥ way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- me·leḵ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: Jephthah again . . . sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: Tornou Jefté a enviar mensageiros ao rei dos filhos de Amom;

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יִפְתָּ֑ח לֹֽא־ לָקַ֤ח יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וְאֶת־ אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw kōh ’ā·mar yip̄·tāḥ lō- lā·qaḥ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ wə·’eṯ- ’e·reṣ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: to tell him This is what Jephthah says Israel did not take away the land of Moab or - of the Ammonites
verses.literalPt: e disse-lhe: Assim diz Jefté: Israel não tomou a terra de Moabe, nem a terra dos filhos de Amom;

verses.original: כִּ֖י בַּעֲלוֹתָ֣ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ עַד־ יַם־ ס֔וּף וַיָּבֹ֖א קָדֵֽשָׁה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ba·‘ă·lō·w·ṯām mim·miṣ·rā·yim way·yê·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl bam·miḏ·bār ‘aḏ- yam- sūp̄ way·yā·ḇō qā·ḏê·šāh
verses.literal: But when Israel came up out of Egypt they traveled through the wilderness to the Red Sea and came to Kadesh
verses.literalPt: mas, quando Israel subiu do Egito e andou pelo deserto até o mar Vermelho e chegou a Cades,

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְאָכִ֣ים׀ אֶל־ מֶלֶךְ֩ אֱד֨וֹם׀ לֵאמֹ֜ר אֶעְבְּרָה־ נָּ֣א בְאַרְצֶ֗ךָ וְלֹ֤א שָׁמַע֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֔וֹם וְגַ֨ם אֶל־ מֶ֧לֶךְ מוֹאָ֛ב שָׁלַ֖ח וְלֹ֣א אָבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּקָדֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yiś·rā·’êl mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm lê·mōr ’e‘·bə·rāh- nā ḇə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā wə·lō šā·ma‘ me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·ḡam ’el- me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ šā·laḥ wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh way·yê·šeḇ yiś·rā·’êl bə·qā·ḏêš
verses.literal: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom saying Please let us pass through your land but the king of Edom would not listen They also sent messengers to the king of Moab but he would not consent So Israel stayed in Kadesh
verses.literalPt: enviou mensageiros ao rei de Edom, que lhe dissessem: Deixa-me passar pela tua terra. Mas o rei de Edom não lhe deu ouvidos. Enviou também ao rei de Moabe, mas este não consentiu; assim, Israel ficou em Cades.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיָּ֜סָב אֶת־ אֶ֤רֶץ אֱדוֹם֙ וְאֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיָּבֹ֤א מִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ לְאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּן בְּעֵ֣בֶר אַרְנ֑וֹן וְלֹא־ בָ֙אוּ֙ בִּגְב֣וּל מוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י אַרְנ֖וֹן גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bam·miḏ·bār way·yā·sāḇ ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·’eṯ- ’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ way·yā·ḇō mim·miz·raḥ- še·meš lə·’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ way·ya·ḥă·nūn bə·‘ê·ḇer ’ar·nō·wn wə·lō- ḇā·’ū biḡ·ḇūl mō·w·’āḇ kî ’ar·nō·wn gə·ḇūl mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Then Israel traveled through the wilderness and bypassed the lands of Edom and Moab They came to the east side of the land of Moab and camped on the other side of the Arnon But they did not enter the territory of Moab since the Arnon was its border
verses.literalPt: Depois, andou pelo deserto, e rodeou a terra de Edom e a terra de Moabe, e veio pelo lado oriental da terra de Moabe, e se acampou da outra banda de Arnom; porém não entrou no território de Moabe, porque Arnom era o termo de Moabe.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־ סִיח֥וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נַעְבְּרָה־ נָּ֥א בְאַרְצְךָ֖ עַד־ מְקוֹמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yiś·rā·’êl mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn way·yō·mer lōw yiś·rā·’êl na‘·bə·rāh- nā ḇə·’ar·ṣə·ḵā ‘aḏ- mə·qō·w·mî
verses.literal: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites who ruled in Heshbon and said to him Please let us pass through your land into our own place
verses.literalPt: Israel enviou mensageiros a Seom, rei dos amorreus, rei de Hesbom, e disse-lhe: Deixa-nos passar pela tua terra ao meu lugar.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ הֶאֱמִ֨ין סִיח֤וֹן אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֲבֹ֣ר בִּגְבֻל֔וֹ וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף סִיחוֹן֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּ֔וֹ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּיָ֑הְצָה וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- he·’ĕ·mîn sî·ḥō·wn ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ă·ḇōr biḡ·ḇu·lōw way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ sî·ḥō·wn ’eṯ- kāl- ‘am·mōw way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·yā·hə·ṣāh way·yil·lā·ḥem ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But Sihon would not trust Israel to pass through his territory So he gathered all his people encamped in Jahaz and fought with Israel
verses.literalPt: Mas Seom recusou deixar passar Israel pelo seu território; pelo contrário, tendo Seom ajuntado todas as suas forças, acampou-se em Jaza e pelejou contra Israel.

verses.original: וַ֠יִּתֵּן יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ סִיח֧וֹן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּ֛וֹ בְּיַ֥ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיַּכּ֑וּם וַיִּירַשׁ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- sî·ḥō·wn wə·’eṯ- kāl- ‘am·mōw bə·yaḏ yiś·rā·’êl way·yak·kūm way·yî·raš yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ ha·hî
verses.literal: Then the LORD the God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel who defeated them So Israel took possession of all the land of the Amorites who inhabited that country
verses.literalPt: Jeová, Deus de Israel, entregou-o com todas as suas forças nas mãos de Israel, que os feriu; assim se fez senhor de toda a terra dos amorreus, que habitavam naquele país.

verses.original: וַיִּ֣ירְשׁ֔וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ גְּב֣וּל הָאֱמֹרִ֑י מֵֽאַרְנוֹן֙ וְעַד־ הַיַּבֹּ֔ק וּמִן־ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְעַד־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rə·šū ’êṯ kāl- gə·ḇūl hā·’ĕ·mō·rî mê·’ar·nō·wn wə·‘aḏ- hay·yab·bōq ū·min- ham·miḏ·bār wə·‘aḏ- hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: seizing all the land . . . from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Tomaram posse de todo o território dos amorreus, desde Arnom até Jaboque e desde o deserto até o Jordão.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י מִפְּנֵ֖י עַמּ֣וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּירָשֶֽׁנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hō·w·rîš ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî mip·pə·nê ‘am·mōw yiś·rā·’êl wə·’at·tāh tî·rā·šen·nū
verses.literal: Now since the LORD the God of Israel has driven out the Amorites from before His people Israel should you now possess it
verses.literalPt: Assim, Jeová, Deus de Israel, desapossou os amorreus de diante do seu povo de Israel, e hás de tu possuir este território?

verses.original: הֲלֹ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר יוֹרִֽישְׁךָ֛ כְּמ֥וֹשׁ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אוֹת֥וֹ תִירָ֑שׁ וְאֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹרִ֜ישׁ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ מִפָּנֵ֖ינוּ אוֹת֥וֹ נִירָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ’êṯ ’ă·šer yō·w·rî·šə·ḵā kə·mō·wōš ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ō·w·ṯōw ṯî·rāš wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer hō·w·rîš Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū mip·pā·nê·nū ’ō·w·ṯōw nî·rāš
verses.literal: Do you not possess whatever your god Chemosh grants you So also we possess whatever the LORD our God has granted us
verses.literalPt: Não possuirás tu o território dos que desapossar Camos, teu deus? Assim, possuiremos nós o território de todos os que desapossar, diante de nós, Jeová, nosso Deus .

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֲט֥וֹב טוֹב֙ אַתָּ֔ה מִבָּלָ֥ק בֶּן־ צִפּ֖וֹר מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֑ב הֲר֥וֹב רָב֙ עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־ נִלְחֹ֥ם נִלְחַ֖ם בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hă·ṭō·wḇ ṭō·wḇ ’at·tāh mib·bā·lāq ben- ṣip·pō·wr me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ hă·rō·wḇ rāḇ ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl ’im- nil·ḥōm nil·ḥam bām
verses.literal: Are you now so much better . . . than Balak son of Zippor king of Moab Did he ever contend . . . with Israel or fight . . . against them
verses.literalPt: És tu melhor do que Balaque, filho de Zipor, rei de Moabe? Porventura contendeu ele, em algum tempo, com Israel ou lhe fez guerra alguma vez ?

verses.original: בְּשֶׁ֣בֶת יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל בְּחֶשְׁבּ֨וֹן וּבִבְנוֹתֶ֜יהָ וּבְעַרְע֣וֹר וּבִבְנוֹתֶ֗יהָ וּבְכָל־ הֶֽעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ יְדֵ֣י אַרְנ֔וֹן שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וּמַדּ֥וּעַ לֹֽא־ הִצַּלְתֶּ֖ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·še·ḇeṯ yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḥeš·bō·wn ū·ḇiḇ·nō·w·ṯe·hā ū·ḇə·‘ar·‘ō·wr ū·ḇiḇ·nō·w·ṯe·hā ū·ḇə·ḵāl he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer ‘al- yə·ḏê ’ar·nō·wn šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh ū·mad·dū·a‘ lō- hiṣ·ṣal·tem bā·‘êṯ ha·hî
verses.literal: For three hundred years Israel has lived in Heshbon Aroer and their villages as well as all the cities along the banks of the Arnon Why did you not take them back during that time
verses.literalPt: Durante os trezentos anos que Israel habitou em Hesbom e suas vilas, e em Aroer e suas vilas, e em todas as cidades vizinhas ao Arnom; por que não as recuperastes nesse tempo?

verses.original: וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ לֹֽא־ חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔ךְ וְאַתָּ֞ה עֹשֶׂ֥ה אִתִּ֛י רָעָ֖ה לְהִלָּ֣חֶם בִּ֑י יִשְׁפֹּ֨ט יְהוָ֤ה הַשֹּׁפֵט֙ הַיּ֔וֹם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō- ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lāḵ wə·’at·tāh ‘ō·śeh ’it·tî rā·‘āh lə·hil·lā·ḥem bî yiš·pōṭ Yah·weh haš·šō·p̄êṭ hay·yō·wm bên bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇên bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: I have not sinned against you but you have done me wrong by waging war against me May the LORD the Judge decide today between the Israelites . . . . . . and the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: Não sou eu, portanto, quem pecou contra ti, és tu, porém, que me estás fazendo injúria a mim, declarando-me a guerra. Jeová, que hoje é árbitro, julgue entre os filhos de Israel e os filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔ע מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יִפְתָּ֔ח אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלַ֖ח אֵלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šā·ma‘ me·leḵ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ’el- diḇ·rê yip̄·tāḥ ’ă·šer šā·laḥ ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: But the king of the Ammonites . . . paid no heed to the message Jephthah sent him
verses.literalPt: Todavia, o rei dos filhos de Amom não deu ouvidos à mensagem que Jefté lhe enviou.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֤י עַל־ יִפְתָּח֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּעֲבֹ֥ר אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲבֹר֙ אֶת־ מִצְפֵּ֣ה גִלְעָ֔ד וּמִמִּצְפֵּ֣ה גִלְעָ֔ד עָבַ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ‘al- yip̄·tāḥ rū·aḥ Yah·weh way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·’eṯ- mə·naš·šeh way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- miṣ·pêh ḡil·‘āḏ ū·mim·miṣ·pêh ḡil·‘āḏ ‘ā·ḇar bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah and he passed through Gilead and Manasseh then through Mizpah of Gilead And from there . . . he advanced against the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: Tendo o Espírito de Jeová vindo sobre Jefté, atravessou ele a Gileade e a Manassés e, passando por Mispa de Gileade, dali foi aos filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וַיִּדַּ֨ר יִפְתָּ֥ח נֶ֛דֶר לַיהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אִם־ נָת֥וֹן תִּתֵּ֛ן אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן בְּיָדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yid·dar yip̄·tāḥ ne·ḏer Yah·weh way·yō·mar ’im- nā·ṯō·wn tit·tên ’eṯ- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn bə·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: Jephthah made this vow to the LORD . . . If indeed You will deliver the Ammonites . . . into my hand
verses.literalPt: Fez Jefté um voto a Jeová e disse: Se, na verdade, me entregares nas mãos os filhos de Amom,

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה הַיּוֹצֵ֗א אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵצֵ֜א מִדַּלְתֵ֤י בֵיתִי֙ לִקְרָאתִ֔י בְּשׁוּבִ֥י בְשָׁל֖וֹם מִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהָיָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהַעֲלִיתִ֖הוּ עוֹלָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh hay·yō·w·ṣê ’ă·šer yê·ṣê mid·dal·ṯê ḇê·ṯî liq·rā·ṯî bə·šū·ḇî ḇə·šā·lō·wm mib·bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn wə·hā·yāh Yah·weh wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯi·hū ‘ō·w·lāh
verses.literal: then whatever . . . comes out the door of my house to greet me on my triumphant return from the Ammonites . . . will belong to the LORD and I will offer it up as a burnt offering
verses.literalPt: a pessoa, seja ela qual for, que sair da porta da minha casa ao meu encontro, quando eu voltar vitorioso dos filhos de Amom, será de Jeová, e eu a oferecerei em holocausto.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֥ר יִפְתָּ֛ח אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְהִלָּ֣חֶם בָּ֑ם וַיִתְּנֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr yip̄·tāḥ ’el- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn lə·hil·lā·ḥem bām wa·yit·tə·nēm Yah·weh bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: So Jephthah crossed over to the Ammonites . . . to fight against them and the LORD delivered them into his hand
verses.literalPt: Assim, passou Jefté aos filhos de Amom, a pelejar contra eles; e Jeová entregou-os nas mãos dele.

verses.original: וַיַּכֵּ֡ם מֵעֲרוֹעֵר֩ וְעַד־ בּוֹאֲךָ֨ מִנִּ֜ית עֶשְׂרִ֣ים עִ֗יר וְעַד֙ אָבֵ֣ל כְּרָמִ֔ים מַכָּ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּכָּֽנְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kêm mê·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr wə·‘aḏ- bō·w·’ă·ḵā min·nîṯ ‘eś·rîm ‘îr wə·‘aḏ ’ā·ḇêl kə·rā·mîm mak·kāh gə·ḏō·w·lāh mə·’ōḏ way·yik·kā·nə·‘ū bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: With a great . . . blow he devastated twenty cities from Aroer to the vicinity of Minnith as far as Abel-keramim . . . So the Ammonites . . . were subdued before the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Jefté feriu-os com grande mortandade desde Aroer até chegar a Minite, numas vinte cidades, e até Abel-Queramim. Foram subjugados os filhos de Amom diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יִפְתָּ֣ח הַמִּצְפָּה֮ אֶל־ בֵּיתוֹ֒ וְהִנֵּ֤ה בִתּוֹ֙ יֹצֵ֣את לִקְרָאת֔וֹ בְתֻפִּ֖ים וּבִמְחֹל֑וֹת וְרַק֙ הִ֣יא יְחִידָ֔ה אֵֽין־ ל֥וֹ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ בֵּ֖ן אוֹ־ בַֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yip̄·tāḥ ham·miṣ·pāh ’el- bê·ṯōw wə·hin·nêh ḇit·tōw yō·ṣêṯ liq·rā·ṯōw ḇə·ṯup·pîm ū·ḇim·ḥō·lō·wṯ wə·raq hî yə·ḥî·ḏāh ’ên- lōw mim·men·nū bên ’ōw- ḇaṯ
verses.literal: And when Jephthah returned home to Mizpah there was his daughter coming out to meet him with tambourines and dancing . . . She was his only child he had no son or daughter besides her
verses.literalPt: Jefté voltou para sua casa em Mispa, e saiu-lhe ao encontro sua filha com tambores e com danças. Ela era a filha única; além dela não tinha outro filho nem filha.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִרְאוֹת֨וֹ אוֹתָ֜הּ וַיִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֲהָ֤הּ בִּתִּי֙ הַכְרֵ֣עַ הִכְרַעְתִּ֔נִי וְאַ֖תְּ הָיִ֣יתְ בְּעֹֽכְרָ֑י וְאָנֹכִ֗י פָּצִ֤יתִי־ פִי֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵir·’ō·w·ṯōw ’ō·w·ṯāh way·yiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw way·yō·mer ’ă·hāh bit·tî haḵ·rê·a‘ hiḵ·ra‘·ti·nî wə·’at hå̄·yīṯ bə·‘ō·ḵə·rāy wə·’ā·nō·ḵî pā·ṣî·ṯî- p̄î ’el- Yah·weh wə·lō ’ū·ḵal lā·šūḇ
verses.literal: As soon as Jephthah saw her he tore his clothes and said No Not my daughter You have brought me to my knees . . . You . . . have brought great misery upon me for I have given my word . . . to the LORD and cannot . . . take it back
verses.literalPt: Quando a viu, rasgou os seus vestidos e disse: Ai de mim, filha minha! Tu me arruinaste e te fizeste a causa da minha calamidade; porquanto dei a minha palavra a Jeová e não posso voltar atrás.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אָבִי֙ פָּצִ֤יתָה אֶת־ פִּ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֣ה לִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יָצָ֣א מִפִּ֑יךָ אַחֲרֵ֡י אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ לְךָ֙ יְהוָ֧ה נְקָמ֛וֹת מֵאֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִבְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ā·ḇî pā·ṣî·ṯāh ’eṯ- pî·ḵā ’el- Yah·weh ‘ă·śêh lî ka·’ă·šer yā·ṣā mip·pî·ḵā ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·ḵā Yah·weh nə·qā·mō·wṯ mê·’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā mib·bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: My father she replied you have given your word - to the LORD Do to me as you have said . . . for the LORD has avenged you of your enemies the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: Ela lhe respondeu: Pai meu, deste a tua palavra a Jeová; faze a mim conforme o que prometeste, pois que Jeová te vingou dos teus inimigos, dos filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אָבִ֔יהָ יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לִּ֖י הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה הַרְפֵּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜נִּי שְׁנַ֣יִם חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וְאֵֽלְכָה֙ וְיָרַדְתִּ֣י עַל־ הֶֽהָרִ֔ים וְאֶבְכֶּה֙ עַל־ בְּתוּלַ֔י אָנֹכִ֖י וְרֵעְיֹתָי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’el- ’ā·ḇî·hā yê·‘ā·śeh lî had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh har·pêh mim·men·nî šə·na·yim ḥo·ḏā·šîm wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh wə·yā·raḏ·tî ‘al- he·hā·rîm wə·’eḇ·keh ‘al- bə·ṯū·lay ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·rē·ʿə·yō·ṯå̄y
verses.literal: She also said to her father Let me do . . . this . . . . . . one thing Let me wander . . . for two months through the mountains . . . with my friends and mourn . . . my virginity
verses.literalPt: Disse a seu pai: Seja isto feito a meu favor: deixa-me por dois meses, para que eu vá e desça pelos montes, chorando a minha virgindade com as minhas companheiras.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לֵ֔כִי וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח אוֹתָ֖הּ שְׁנֵ֣י חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַתֵּ֤לֶךְ הִיא֙ וְרֵ֣עוֹתֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֥בְךְּ עַל־ בְּתוּלֶ֖יהָ עַל־ הֶהָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lê·ḵî way·yiš·laḥ ’ō·w·ṯāh šə·nê ḥo·ḏā·šîm wat·tê·leḵ hî wə·rê·‘ō·w·ṯe·hā wat·tê·ḇək ‘al- bə·ṯū·le·hā ‘al- he·hā·rîm
verses.literal: Go he said And he sent her away for two months So she left with her friends and mourned her virginity upon the mountains
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe ele: Vai. Deixou-a ir por dois meses; então se foi ela com as suas companheiras e chorou a sua virgindade nos montes.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ שְׁנַ֣יִם חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וַתָּ֙שָׁב֙ אֶל־ אָבִ֔יהָ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לָ֔הּ אֶת־ נִדְר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָדָ֑ר וְהִיא֙ לֹא־ יָדְעָ֣ה אִ֔ישׁ וַתְּהִי־ חֹ֖ק בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ šə·na·yim ḥo·ḏā·šîm wat·tā·šāḇ ’el- ’ā·ḇî·hā way·ya·‘aś lāh ’eṯ- niḏ·rōw ’ă·šer nā·ḏār wə·hî lō- yā·ḏə·‘āh ’îš wat·tə·hî- ḥōq bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: After two months she returned to her father and he did to her as he had vowed And she had never had relations with a man So it has become a custom in Israel
verses.literalPt: Passados os dois meses, tornou ela para seu pai, o qual lhe fez segundo o seu voto: ela não tinha conhecido varão. Veio a ser costume em Israel,

verses.original: מִיָּמִ֣ים׀ יָמִ֗ימָה תֵּלַ֙כְנָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְתַנּ֕וֹת לְבַת־ יִפְתָּ֖ח הַגִּלְעָדִ֑י אַרְבַּ֥עַת יָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mî·yā·mîm yā·mî·māh tê·laḵ·nāh bə·nō·wṯ yiś·rā·’êl lə·ṯan·nō·wṯ lə·ḇaṯ- yip̄·tāḥ hag·gil·‘ā·ḏî ’ar·ba·‘aṯ yā·mîm baš·šā·nāh
verses.literal: that each . . . year the young women of Israel go out for four days to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite
verses.literalPt: o irem de ano em ano as filhas de Israel a chorar a filha de Jefté por quatro dias.
